mapper.sql: id, parent_id, org_type, org_code, org_name, path_ids, full_path, depth, sort_order, description, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by
mapper.select: SELECT FROM system_org WHERE id = #{orgId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM system_org WHERE path_ids LIKE CONCAT(#{pathIds}, '%') ORDER BY depth, id FOR UPDATE
SELECT MAX(depth) FROM system_org WHERE path_ids LIKE CONCAT(#{pathIds}, '%')

WITH candidates AS ( SELECT candidate.source_row, candidate.parent_code, candidate.org_name FROM JSON_TABLE( #{candidatesJson}, '$[*]' COLUMNS ( source_row INT PATH '$.rowNumber', parent_code VARCHAR(64) PATH '$.parentCode', org_name VARCHAR(100) PATH '$.orgName' ) ) AS candidate ), ranked AS ( SELECT source_row, MIN(source_row) OVER ( PARTITION BY parent_code COLLATE utf8mb4_bin, org_name COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci ) AS first_source_row FROM candidates ) SELECT source_row AS rowNumber, first_source_row AS firstRowNumber FROM ranked WHERE source_row > 0 AND source_row != first_source_row ORDER BY source_row
mapper.update: UPDATE system_org SET org_code = CASE WHEN id = #{orgId} THEN #{orgCode} ELSE org_code END, org_name = CASE WHEN id = #{orgId} THEN #{orgName} ELSE org_name END, sort_order = CASE WHEN id = #{orgId} THEN #{sortOrder} ELSE sort_order END, description = CASE WHEN id = #{orgId} THEN #{description} ELSE description END, full_path = CONCAT( #{newFullPath}, SUBSTRING(full_path, CHAR_LENGTH(#{oldFullPath}) + 1) ), updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE path_ids LIKE CONCAT(#{pathIds}, '%')

UPDATE system_org SET parent_id = CASE WHEN id = #{orgId} THEN #{newParentId} ELSE parent_id END, path_ids = CONCAT( #{newPathIds}, SUBSTRING(path_ids, CHAR_LENGTH(#{oldPathIds}) + 1) ), full_path = CONCAT( #{newFullPath}, SUBSTRING(full_path, CHAR_LENGTH(#{oldFullPath}) + 1) ), depth = depth + #{depthDelta}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE path_ids LIKE CONCAT(#{oldPathIds}, '%')
